answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. By the dune of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Every claim climbs the river of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the copper re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts split across independent auditors. Written in a concise reports, one example per claim register, it stays short.
